p: sanctuary: By the sanctuary he means all the tabernacle.
they brought yet unto him free: Meaning, the Israelites.
much more than enough for the: A rare example and notable to see the people so ready to serve God with their goods.
cherubims of cunning work made he: Which were little pictures with wings in the form of children.
covering for the tent of rams': These two were above the covering of goat's hair.
standing up: And to bear up the curtains of the tabernacle.
westward he made six boards: Or, toward the Mediterranean Sea, west of Jerusalem,
vail of blue: Which was between the sanctuary and the holiest of holies.
hanging for the tabernacle door of: Which was between the court and the sanctuary.
